overview_description.description: Cohere's offerings include generative models for text and reasoning, speech recognition systems, and tools for embedding and reranking data to improve search and discovery. The company enables deployment across private cloud, on-premises, or managed environments, allowing organizations to maintain control over their data and infrastructure. Cohere also provides platforms that connect enterprise tools and workflows, supporting use cases such as knowledge management, automation, and analytics.

about_short_description.short_description: Cohere develops enterprise artificial intelligence software and provides language models, retrieval tools, and workplace platforms.

product.name: North
product.description: An enterprise AI platform for workplace productivity that combines agentic automation, workflow support, and retrieval grounded in organizational data.

product.name: Command
product.description: A family of generative language models for enterprise applications, including content generation, reasoning, multilingual communication, and data-grounded insights.

product.name: Embed
product.description: A semantic representation model that converts text and other supported content into vectors for document comparison, search, and retrieval.

product.name: Rerank
product.description: A relevance-ranking model that refines search results by ordering retrieved documents according to their semantic relevance to a query.

product.name: Compass
product.description: An enterprise search and discovery system that helps users surface business insights from organizational information.

product.name: Private Deployments
product.description: Deployment options for running Cohere AI capabilities in a dedicated virtual private cloud or on-premises, including air-gapped environments.
